# PennyWise

> PennyWise is a free personal daily finance tracker for Malaysia. It helps users manage income, recurring bills and subscriptions, daily expenses, debts, investments, and an emergency backup fund. It keeps a running daily budget and carries any overspending forward to the next day. All amounts are in Malaysian Ringgit (RM).

## What it does
- Daily budget that carries forward: set a daily spending limit; whatever you overspend one day rolls into the next, so the balance shown is the money you have left.
- Income with Malaysian statutory deductions: works out EPF, SOCSO and EIS, accepts PCB, and stores your real take-home pay.
- Recurring bills and subscriptions: track monthly bills, mark them paid, see what is still due.
- Debts: track money you owe and money owed to you, and mark a debt settled once it is paid.
- Investments: trading (buy/sell with quantity and price), unit trust / ASNB (save/redeem/dividend), savings / Tabung Haji (deposit/withdraw/dividend).
- Backup/emergency fund: deposits and withdrawals.
- AI assistant: add entries and ask questions by voice or text; the assistant suggests each entry and saves nothing until you confirm.

## Who it is for
Individuals in Malaysia who want a simple daily view of personal cash flow in Ringgit (RM).

## Access & privacy
Free to use with an email account. Data is per-user and protected by row-level security; optional two-factor authentication (TOTP) is supported. The app itself is private and requires login; the public marketing page describes the product.

## Key public pages
- /: overview of features and FAQ
- /signup: create a free account
- /login: sign in
